title: phyllanthera papillata
intro: Phyllanthera papillata, commonly known as the toothed Phyllanthera, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthera papillata include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
